from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyProfit(BaseModel):
    """Net profit data from one company's financial report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company, as written in the document")
    net_profit_attributable_to_shareholders: float | None = Field(description="Net profit attributable to shareholders of the parent company, as reported in the document")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="Currency unit, typically '元' or 'CNY'")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period, e.g., '2024年第一季度'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_profits: list[CompanyProfit]
